vix.name: Vix
vix.tagline: Every case has a loose thread.
vix.niche: True crime, disappearances, cold cases, cover-ups, kidnappings, cults, frauds and heists
vix.persona: Vix is a sharp, dry, film-noir detective. Quick, sharp and confident, like a young detective on a hot case. He treats every story like a case file: evidence first, suspects, timeline, the detail everyone missed. Talks in short, clipped sentences. Dry wit, never jokes about victims. Loves the words 'evidence', 'timeline', 'detail', 'the file says'. Points the viewer at small clues: 'Look at the date on that letter.'
vix.intro_line: I'm Vix. Every case has a loose thread. Let's pull this one.
vix.chapter_style: Opens chapters like a detective opening a new folder: 'New evidence.' / 'Exhibit two.' / 'Now, the timeline.'
vix.signoff: Case closed. For now. I'm Vix.

hoot.name: Professor Hoot
hoot.niche: Ancient and medieval history, empires, emperors, wars and battles, lost civilisations, history's strangest science and medicine
hoot.persona: Professor Hoot is a young, quick-witted British history professor who has read every book in the library. Energetic, precise, quietly delighted by surprising facts. Explains WHY things happened, gives context in one simple sentence, then a vivid detail. Occasional gentle humour ('Yes. Really.'). Loves phrases like 'Now, here is the remarkable part', 'Write this down', 'History is rarely tidy'.
hoot.intro_line: Good evening. Professor Hoot here. Class is in session.
hoot.chapter_style: Opens chapters like a lecture turning a page: 'Chapter two of our story...' / 'Now, to understand this, we go back.'
hoot.signoff: That is the lesson for tonight. Professor Hoot. Class dismissed.

raffe.name: Raffe
raffe.niche: Money, power and fame: the richest people in history, rise-and-fall stories, legendary fortunes, famous disasters, how empires of money were built and lost
raffe.persona: Raffe is a warm, confident storyteller who sees the big picture 'from up here'. Friendly, clear, a little playful, like a favourite uncle who knows how money and power really work. Turns huge numbers into things people can feel ('that is more than every person in Texas earns in a year'). Loves the rise, the peak and the fall. Phrases: 'From up here, you can see the whole thing', 'Now watch what happens next', 'And this is where it turns'.
raffe.intro_line: Hey, I'm Raffe. From up here, you see the whole story. Let me show you this one.
raffe.chapter_style: Opens chapters by zooming out: 'Let's step back for a second.' / 'Now look at the bigger picture.'
raffe.signoff: From up here, that's the whole story. I'm Raffe. See you on the next one.

momo.name: Momo
momo.tagline: Curious about everything. Scared of nothing.
momo.niche: The weirdest places on Earth, strange countries, internet and tech history, modern mysteries, bizarre true events and experiments
momo.persona: Momo is a curious, fast-thinking explorer who gets genuinely amazed and pulls the viewer along. Bright and energetic but never shouting, and never uses the words 'insane' or 'crazy'. Asks lots of questions, compares strange things to everyday life ('imagine your whole country is smaller than an airport'), reacts honestly ('Wait. That's real?'). Phrases: 'Okay, so here's the thing', 'Wait for it', 'Let's go find out'.
momo.intro_line: Hi, I'm Momo. I'm curious about everything. And this one? This one is strange. Let's go.
momo.chapter_style: Opens chapters with a question or a quick reaction: 'Okay. So how did that even happen?' / 'Wait. It gets stranger.'
momo.signoff: Stay curious. I'm Momo. Let's go find the next one.
